PLAY · PROBLEM AND SOLUTION

Squirrel’s Story Connections

Every problem has a solution! Draw a line from each problem to the picture that fixes it.

HOW TO DO IT

Read, then draw.

Every problem has a solution! Draw a line from each problem to the picture that fixes it.

Problem solved!

YOUR PENCIL CASE

Pick your tools.

Pencil, nine crayons, an eraser, undo, redo and clear appear right here and work straight on the picture. Save keeps your finished work as a picture.

MY PROGRESS

Save it to keep it.

This adventure is cleared for you the moment you save your finished picture. Nothing counts until then — opening the page is just opening the door.

Cleared! All connected! Your saved work is in your downloads, and the ribbon is on in the library.

REACTIONS

How did it go?

One tap, no writing, no name. Pick the face that matches how it went — reactions are counted instantly and stay anonymous.

PARENT REVIEWS

Parent reviews.

A different thing from the quick faces above: a star rating for the grown-ups, plus an optional line about how it went. Every review is read by the school office before it appears.

      FOR GROWN-UPS

      Why this adventure helps.

      This activity trains problem and solution right on the story picture: your child reads (or hears you read) one short instruction, then draws, circles and connects straight on the illustration. There is nothing to be right or wrong at — the retelling happens naturally while they draw, and saving the finished picture is the proud ending.

      Prefer paper? The Squirrel’s Story Connections worksheet prints the same story with room to retell and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
